title: Senior security engineer (SIEM / IR / cloud)
description: An 8-year senior security engineer (Splunk SIEM, incident response, Python SOAR automation, AWS security) evaluated against 8 postings: one strong fintech staff role with Kubernetes-security and Go/GCP gaps, one semantically equivalent defensive-security role written with zero brand names, one marginal platform-engineering role, and five unrelated distractors.
rationale: A senior-level security scenario stressing semantic matching. j2 is the semantic-no-keyword-overlap job: it describes exactly the resume's core competency — SIEM pipelines, incident response, Python automation, cloud hardening — using only generic vocabulary ('defensive monitoring pipelines', 'breach triage', 'scripting in a high-level language for security tooling', 'a major public cloud') that shares almost no tokens with the resume's branded skill names (Splunk, CrowdStrike, SOAR, AWS, MITRE ATT&CK); TF-IDF gets no signal while embeddings should rank it grade 2. Gap target j1 is a grade-3 fintech staff role overlapping heavily on Splunk detection engineering, incident response leadership, Python, AWS security, and Terraform, but it requires Kubernetes security the resume never touches (high) plus Go, GCP, and CISSP at the preferred tier; GCP is graded medium because deep AWS security experience partially transfers. j3 probes the graded boundary: a platform-engineering role with genuine Terraform/AWS/Python overlap but a different job family. j5 (physical security site supervisor) shares only the surface words 'security' and 'incident report' and must stay at grade 0.

Staff Security Engineer — Ledgerline (Remote, US)

Ledgerline processes card payments for 9,000 online merchants; security is a product feature here, not a cost center. We are hiring a Staff Security Engineer to lead detection and response across our cloud platform.

What you will do:
- Own detection engineering across AWS workloads and the Splunk pipeline
- Lead incident response for production security events and run post-incident reviews
- Secure our Kubernetes clusters and CI/CD supply chain
- Codify cloud security guardrails with Terraform

Requirements: SIEM detection engineering (Splunk or Elastic), incident response leadership, Python, AWS security, and Kubernetes security (admission control, runtime detection, network policy). 7+ years in security engineering or security operations, with a prior lead role on major security incidents. Bachelor's in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have: Go, GCP, CISSP.

jobs.raw_text:
Defensive Security Engineer — Quarrystone Systems (Hybrid, Portland OR)

Quarrystone runs logistics software for freight forwarders, and our small security team defends it. We deliberately avoid tool-brand shopping lists — we care about what you can do, not which vendor you did it with.

You will build and tune the pipelines that collect logs from our server fleet and surface suspicious activity, coordinate breach triage from first alert through post-mortem, write scripts in a high-level language to glue our security tooling together, and harden accounts and workloads in a major public cloud.

We look for: experience running an organization's defensive monitoring stack, calm hands-on breach triage, scripting fluency for security tooling, and cloud hardening fundamentals. 6+ years defending production environments. Bonus: familiarity with adversary-behavior catalogues, mentoring junior analysts.
